newsitem.title: USA: General Growth completes CenterMark sale.
newsitem.headline: General Growth completes CenterMark sale.

text.p: General Growth Properties Inc said Thursday it completed the sale of its remaining stock in CenterMark Properties Inc for $130.5 million.
The real estate investment trust received a total of $290 million for the entire sale of its investment in CenterMark, General Growth said.
The $130.5 million received Thursday will be used to reduce short term floating rate debt incurred in recent property acquisitions, General Growth said.
General Growth shares fell 1/2 to 31-3/4 Thursday.
